sloka: तस्मादद्यैव बध्नन्तु सेतुम् वानरपुङ्गवाः ।ततो निसृष्ट रामेण सर्वतो हरि यूथपाः ॥६-२२-५२॥।।
transliteration: tasmādadyaiva badhnantu setum vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।tato nisṛṣṭa rāmeṇa sarvato hari yūthapāḥ ॥6-22-52॥।।

translations.english: Then directed by Rama the Vanara troop leaders in hundreds and thousands sprang up gladly all over the huge forest.
